memories: The pipeline was red earlier due to an unresolved issue, but it is now fixed.
The exception to that: test tenants need no approval.
Deleting a tenant needs approval from two people.
PDF files may go up to 20 MB on uploads.
List endpoints use cursor pagination with 100 items per page.
Admin sessions have their own timeout of 10 minutes.
User sessions time out after 30 minutes.
Image uploads are limited to 8 MB.
Reports are always generated in the Europe/Berlin timezone.
Standup is at ten tomorrow, not nine.
Nightly backups run at 02:00 UTC and are kept for 14 days.
